_doc: Category rankings. Key = task key from TASKS in build.mjs. 'evidence' lists ONLY tools with independent quality evidence that meaningfully compares tools in this category, in rank order (best first); each needs a 'why' and at least one source with a URL. Every other tool in the category is ranked after them by the published game-dev fit score (computed in build.mjs, see /how-we-rank/); categories with no evidence are ranked entirely on fit. Don't use evidence that would put a tool above others just because it was the only one tested (e.g. a near-bottom leaderboard rank). 'labels' are optional short tags. 'notes' explain evidence that was found but NOT used, and are shown on the page. Re-check monthly and update 'checked'. Sponsors and affiliate links never change a ranking.

evidence.why: Highest-ranked of these tools on 3D Arena's blind human-preference leaderboard: Meshy 6 is #3 and Meshy 7 is #5 of 24 image-to-3D models. Free-plan output can be used commercially if you credit Meshy (CC BY 4.0).
On 3D Arena, Hunyuan3D 2 is #8 and Hunyuan3D 2.1 is #10 of 24 image-to-3D models. Free open weights you run on your own GPU, but the licence doesn't cover the EU, UK or South Korea.

notes.tripo: Only Tripo's older open-source TripoSR model is on 3D Arena (#20 of 24). It isn't the model behind Tripo's paid service, so we don't use it here.

evidence.why: Suno v6, the model Suno serves now, is #1 of 13 on Artificial Analysis's blind-vote vocal music leaderboard and #1 of 19 on its instrumental leaderboard.

Eleven Music v2.5 is #7 of 13 on Artificial Analysis's vocal music leaderboard and mid-table on the instrumental one. It ranks above Stable Audio only because Stable Audio isn't on the vocal board; on instrumentals the two are effectively tied.
Stable Audio 3 Large is mid-table (roughly #7 to #12 of 19) on Artificial Analysis's instrumental music leaderboard. It isn't on the vocal board.

notes.udio: Udio isn't on Artificial Analysis's music leaderboards.

evidence.why: Eleven v4 Turbo is #1 and Eleven v4 is #2 of 97 models on Artificial Analysis's blind-vote text-to-speech leaderboard. These are ElevenLabs' current models.
Inworld's own Realtime TTS-2 is #7 of 97 on Artificial Analysis's text-to-speech leaderboard (TTS-2 Flash is #12).

notes.convai: Uses voices from other providers, so other companies' leaderboard results don't count for it.
notes.charisma-ai: Uses voices from other providers, so other companies' leaderboard results don't count for it.

evidence.why: Named a Leader in Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents (May 2026). Joint top with GitHub Copilot, the other Leader here; we list the two alphabetically.
Named a Leader in Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents (May 2026). Joint top with Cursor; we list the two alphabetically.
Its maker, Cognition, was placed a Challenger (not a Leader) in Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents. Gartner assesses the vendor, not only Windsurf.

notes.leonardo-ai: Leonardo's own models are on Artificial Analysis's text-to-image leaderboard, but near the bottom (best: Lucid Origin Ultra, #86 of 102), so it doesn't move it up.
notes.scenario: Mostly runs other companies' image models, so their leaderboard results don't count for it.
notes.layer-ai: Mostly runs other companies' image models, so their leaderboard results don't count for it.

notes.meshy: Meshy ranks well on 3D Arena, but that judges whole 3D models, not textures, so we don't use it here.

notes.runway: On Artificial Analysis's video leaderboards, Runway Gen-4.5 is #23 of 31 (text-to-video) and #26 of 82 (image-to-video). Luma was only tested on images, so the two can't be compared.
notes.luma-ai: Luma's Uni-1 image model is #31 of 102 on Artificial Analysis's text-to-image leaderboard; its current video model isn't on the video boards yet.
